required_before_start: available physical and available commit each >= 1.3 * conservatively estimated task peak memory

required_while_running.estimate_overrun: stop if task process RSS or private exceeds 1.3*estimated_peak; review estimate instead of silent inflation

estimation: Estimate each new task/stage from its measured runs, array/model/temp sizes and resource evidence. Do not reuse a single permanent GiB threshold. At launch use full peak; while running subtract memory already charged to this task.
legacy_locked_sources: Keep original scientific code and failure evidence unchanged. Implement approved resource changes only through versioned new execution/recovery adapters.
